rv.q: The show does a good job of empowering Juliet, but as it turns out, it is actually Anne Hathaway whose journey we have been watching all along.
You won't find many better nights out in the West End – if music be the food of love, then & Juliet serves up an all-you-can-eat buffet of the highest standard.
Maintaining its freshness and bubbly energy with a recent cast change, the jukebox musical & Juliet looks set to continue wowing it's Prosecco guzzling audiences well into the future.
The company is led by the extraordinary Miriam-Teak Lee in the title role of Juliet, who brings a sizzling presence, incredible vocals and moves to turn her into a force of nature.
& JULIET which opened at Theatre on November 20 is certainly fun and enjoyable.
